decision: Analog Rytm MKII module: rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0009-main-rms, for OS 1.74, imported under GPL-2.0-only with attribution. rytm-mods-src is published with MrScruff's permission.

transformations: mod.json's OS 1.74 port sites (a jmp over 6 stock bytes at 0x401213ca, and two 4-byte pointers at 0x401e14ec and 0x401e14f0 in the compressor view's vtable) became address, length and SHA-256 guards in build.json's 1.74 release.
The OS 1.73 source and sites are not imported: core-ar2 0.3 is for OS 1.74 only.
include/ar2-1.74.inc keeps its path relative to the source, so the .include line in src/main-rms.s is unchanged.
